title: In a Little While We're Going Home
tune: IN A LITTLE WHILE WERE G

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Eb]Let us sing a song that will cheer us by the way,
[Bb]For the [Bb7]night will end in the [Eb]everlasting day,

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Eb]We shall meet at last, When the [Bb7/D]stormy [Cm]winds are [Bb]past,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Eb]We will do the work that our hands may find to do,
[Bb]And the [Bb7]grace of God will our [Eb]daily strength renew,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Eb]We will smooth the path for some weary, wayworn feet,
[Bb]And may [Bb7]loving hearts spread around [Eb]an influence sweet!

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [Eb]There's a rest beyond, there's relief from every care,
[Bb]And no [Bb7]tears shall fall in that [Eb]city bright and fair,
